title: 第861章 灵酒之争二十第860章 灵酒之争十九
lines: 十星灵酿阁内沉寂了良久，才陆续有修士开口，声音里仍带着未曾散尽的难以置信。
“韩夜分明做足了准备——魂影合一、巅峰荒魂术、魂纹骨矛……哪一样不是他压箱底的绝杀？怎么在姜望面前，还是连一剑都接不住？”
“因为乍看之下，这一剑和一个月前他对战韩夜时别无二致，可我总感觉有些不一样了。”
“嗯，我也觉得姜望又变强了，可究竟强在哪里，又说不上来……”
在场一众眼力不俗的修士，将前后两场对决在心中反复比对、拆解、还原，渐渐品出一丝差异。
可无论他们如何追溯，都抓不住那道凌驾于攻防之上的玄妙契机，仿佛隔着一层被雾气笼罩的薄纱，看得见轮廓，却勘不透根本所在。
就在满堂修士暗自揣度之际，擂台之下，一道滚烫灼热的身影骤然起身，打断众人沉思。
此人一袭云纹长袍，周身流转着沸腾岩浆般的赤红灵光，每一步踏下，扑面而来的高温便扭曲周遭空气，隔着数丈都能感受到那股灼人热浪。
他是赤凰州苦修多年的老牌火道天骄，仅凭外放的火道威压便足以压得那些酒会二三档修士纷纷退避。
他没有客套多言，纵身跃入斗法空地，体内火之法则本源毫无保留地尽数爆发。
漫天赤红火海凭空席卷整片擂台，数条鳞甲清晰的赤色火龙盘旋长空，龙吼震得殿内灵晶灯盏剧烈晃动。
熊熊烈焰封锁住了姜望所有闪避空间，高温灼烧之力令四周空间都泛起阵阵扭曲褶皱。
观战众人见状，心中暗想，此人火道造诣如此之高，这一次总能逼出姜望更多手段了吧？
可姜望面色平静，过去、现在、未来三道幻身分立三方，周身淡淡的流纹缓缓浮动，手中万化流银长剑同时凝出五色灵光。
三道身影同时抬剑，发出凝练至极的五行归一斩，横贯长空。
五色剑光掠过火海的刹那，汹涌烈焰如同潮水般向两侧自动分开，火龙躯体撞上剑光瞬间寸寸消融，整片火海硬生生被一剑劈出一条笔直通路。
赤凰火修瞳孔骤缩，心中大骇。
可不等他催动术法，姜望三道幻身已然穿过烈焰，无声出现在他身前半丈之外，剑尖微微震颤，堪堪停在他胸口三寸处。
瞬息之间，胜负再定。
全场再度一片哗然，惊叹之声此起彼伏。
“根本不存在底牌拉扯，全程也没有给对手半点调整、反制的空隙，从姜望出手那一刻，结局便已注定。”
“双方层次差距一目了然，这姜望实在强得可怕。”
议论声尚且在厅堂中回荡，又一道颀长身影自席位间缓步踏出。
此人身着素灰宽袍，行至空地中央，微微拱手，声线平稳无波：
“瀚古州，叶东来。”
仅仅自报名字后，便让殿内喧闹瞬间压低大半，不少阅历深厚的修士神色一凛。
content_en:
There was silence in the Ten Star Spirit Brewing Pavilion for a long time before monks spoke one after another, their voices still filled with unbelievable disbelief.
"Han Ye is clearly well prepared - Soul Shadow Fusion, Peak Desolate Soul Technique, Soul Patterned Bone Spear... Which one of them is not his ultimate killer? Why can't he even catch a sword in front of Jiang Wang?"
"Because at first glance, this sword is the same as when he fought Han Ye a month ago, but I always feel something is different."
"Well, I also think Jiang Wang has become stronger again, but I can't tell where he is..."
The monks with good eyesight present compared, dismantled, and restored the two duels repeatedly in their minds, and gradually tasted the slightest difference.
But no matter how they traced it back, they couldn't grasp the mysterious opportunity that overcame offense and defense. It was as if they could see the outline through a thin veil shrouded in mist, but they couldn't detect the root cause.
Just as the monks in the hall were thinking secretly, a scalding figure suddenly stood up under the ring, interrupting everyone's contemplation.
This man was dressed in a cloud-patterned robe, with a red spiritual light like boiling magma flowing around his body. Every time he took a step, the high temperature that hit his face distorted the surrounding air, and he could feel the scorching heat wave from several feet away.
He is a veteran fire master who has been practicing hard in Chihuang Province for many years. The pressure of fire alone is enough to make the second and third level monks at the reception retreat.
Without any polite words, he jumped into the fighting space, and the source of the law of fire in his body exploded without reservation.
A sea of ​​crimson fire swept across the entire arena out of thin air, and several red fire dragons with clear scales hovered in the sky. The dragon's roar shook the spiritual crystal lamps in the hall violently.
The blazing flames blocked all of Jiang Wang's dodge space, and the high-temperature burning force caused bursts of twisting and folding in the surrounding space.
When everyone watching the battle saw this, they thought to themselves, this person is so accomplished in the way of fire, can he force Jiang Wang to use more tricks this time?
But Jiang Wang's face was calm. The three phantoms of the past, present, and future stood in three directions. Faint flow patterns around his body floated slowly, and the long sword of all forms of liquid silver in his hand simultaneously condensed five-color aura.
The three figures raised their swords at the same time, sending out a condensed five-element slash across the sky.
The moment the five-color sword light passed through the sea of ​​fire, the raging flames automatically separated to both sides like a tide. The fire dragon's body hit the sword light and melted inch by inch, and the entire sea of ​​​​fire was forcibly cut into a straight path with a sword.
The red phoenix fire cultivator's pupils shrank suddenly, and he was horrified.
But before he could activate the technique, Jiang Wang's three phantom bodies had already passed through the flames and appeared silently half a foot away in front of him. The tip of the sword trembled slightly and stopped three inches from his chest.
In an instant, victory or defeat can be decided.
The whole place was in an uproar again, and the voices of exclamation came one after another.
"There was no pulling of cards at all, and there was no room for the opponent to adjust or counterattack during the whole process. From the moment Jiang Wang made his move, the outcome was doomed."
"The level gap between the two sides is clear at a glance. This Jiang Wang is really terrifyingly strong."
The discussion was still echoing in the hall, and another tall figure slowly stepped out from between the seats.
Wearing a plain gray robe, this person walked to the center of the open space, slightly cupped his hands, and said in a steady voice:
"Hanguzhou, Ye Donglai."
After just announcing his name, the noise in the hall was instantly suppressed, and many experienced monks looked stern.
